answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a slashable identity bond: every AI agent must lock stake that is forfeited if its attestations prove fraudulent. A forger who splits one identity into an orchard of fake nodes must post a full bond for each one, so the crystal price of attacking grows linearly with the number of Sybils. Honest attestations earn fees, but a violet bid to vote twice is caught by cross-checking and slashes every bond at once, making the scheme cost far more than it can steal.
